task.title: Recover a freshly reauthenticated provider before stale capability admission rejection

scope.owned_layer: Pre-lock stale provider capability readmission target selection, targeted live auth probing, capability persistence, and supervisor regression evidence.
scope.not_changing: Provider credentials, Codex/Codex2 account separation, canonical task truth, reviewer eligibility, worker or account limits, task priority, dependency semantics, failure-loop or chair-triage policy, queue launch probing, runtime deployment, and product code.

observed_failure.external_change: The operator freshly authenticated /home/lupin/.codex2, but no provider capability refresh or queued Codex2 delivery existed.
observed_failure.deadlock: dispatch_ready_tasks evaluated the stale agent-level capability gate before process_queue could reach refresh_provider_auth_before_dispatch, so the fresh account could not prove recovery.

contract.candidate_gate: A stale-auth probe target exists only when the normal dispatcher has an otherwise eligible task after lifecycle, dependency, active/pending queue, capacity, account quota, failure-loop, chair-triage, and unchanged-event cooldown checks. Only cached provider-auth booleans are ignored during this read-only preflight.
contract.lock_boundary: provider_stale_cache_readmission_probe_targets and its live probe run inside probe_provider_reports before _run_once_locked acquires runtime admission; no task or queue mutation occurs in preflight.
contract.bounded_probing: Stale readmission targets are ordered by the existing weighted agent sequence, de-duplicated by provider account/dispatch group, and capped at one account per cycle by default.
contract.rate_limit: provider_auth_probe_due applies the existing provider success/failure probe intervals before force=True is allowed; persisted failed, ambiguous, and unsupported live attempts therefore cannot be retried every tick.
contract.recovery_authority: Only a normalized probe with source=live may be projected into and persisted through write_provider_capabilities. A live ready=true result restores healthy dispatch fields; cached results never transition the lane.
contract.fail_closed: Revoked, quota, timeout, probe error, unsupported, ambiguous, and exception outcomes leave auth_ready=false and local delivery disabled while recording the explicit probe status/error.
contract.launch_gate: refresh_provider_auth_before_dispatch remains unchanged and still force-probes the exact selected logical owner or slot immediately before worker launch.
contract.identity: Provider keys retain configured punctuation for slot profiles, while target de-duplication uses the existing explicit account identity; Codex and Codex2 remain separate accounts and quota pools.

verification.result: checkout-scoped .venv-pantheon provisioned and dependency imports verified

rollout.source_task: No live supervisor mutation or service restart is authorized by this source task.
rollout.next_task: Run the governed live canary only after this source PR is independently reviewed and merged.
rollout.rollback: Revert the merge commit. The previous stale-cache fail-closed behavior returns; no credential or canonical task state rollback is required.
